profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Developer | .NET 8/7 • Azure • Angular • React | Building Scalable Enterprise Applications for Fortune 500
profile.summary:
Results-driven Senior Full Stack Developer with 17+ years delivering enterprise-grade 
applications for Fortune 500 companies in energy, oil & gas, and government sectors.

🎯 WHAT I DO
I architect and build scalable web applications using the Microsoft .NET ecosystem 
(C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Core/5/7/8), modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular), 
and Azure cloud solutions. I excel at translating complex business requirements into 
high-performance systems that drive operational excellence.

💡 KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
- Led 50+ production releases with 99%+ success rate
- Optimized SQL queries reducing processing time from 45s to 3s (93% improvement)
- Managed offshore teams across multiple time zones
- Reduced manual operations by 60% through Azure Functions automation
- Improved application performance by 40% through strategic refactoring

🛠️ TECHNICAL EXPERTISE
Languages: C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, PHP
Frameworks: .NET 5/7/8, React, Angular, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework
Cloud: Microsoft Azure, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD
Databases: SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, T-SQL Optimization
Tools: Visual Studio, Git, TFS, Postman, Application Insights

🎓 EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS
- BS in Computer Science - Autonomous University of Baja California
- Xamarin Development (Microsoft MVP Instructor)
- IT Project Management

📍 Based in Houston, TX | Open to remote opportunities

positions.description: React, .NET Core, T-SQL, Azure, Azure DevOps.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Angular 7, Angular Material, NgRx, Bootstrap 4, SCSS, Web API 2, Oracle PL/SQL, Visual Studio, TFS.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description:
The project’s objective is to redesign and improves and old web portal used to manage an internal framework for core services, as well as complete pending functionalities in the framework. The new web portal is built on top of .NET Core and implements Telerik Core and KendoUI components. The Core Service’s framework is built on top of the Mere Mortals Framework.

Environment: .NET Core 2.1, C#, Telerik Core, KendoUI, JQuery, CSS, HTML, Bootstrap, SingalR, Mere Mortals Framework, Visual Studio 2017, Oracle, TFS.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description:
The project’s objective was to replace all Syncfusion grids used in an internal web application for sales orders and implement Telerik MVC/Kendo UI grids instead and keep the same look and feel.

Environment: ASP.NET MVC, .NET 4.7.1, C#, Telerik MVC, KendoUI, JQuery, CSS, HTML, Visual Studio 2017, TFS.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description:
The project’s objective was to develop new features to the internal GIS Map web application implementing Bing Maps API, such trace routes, show multiple locations on the map, show infoboxes, manage ajax request to handle a lot of information and improve performance on the map.

Environment: Bing Map API, ASP.NET MVC, .NET 4.5.2, C#, JQuery, CSS, HTML, Visual Studio 2015, TFS, Postman.

positions.title: Hybrid Mobile / Backend Developer
positions.description:
The project objective was to develop a hybrid mobile app that keeps people from Staff informed of all important and urgent events on the company. This app needed to be launched on Android and iOS.

Design and develop JSON based REST service with WCF.
Used of LINQ to query the database on Entity Framework.
Design and create User Interface for the mobile app with JQuery Mobile.
Used of JQuery to fetch data from database consuming the REST service.
Implement Push Notifications to mobile devices using PushBots service.
Used of cordova plugins to download files from service and open it on device.
Publish Android app to Play Store.
Generate iOS certificate and provisioning files to test and publish app to AppStore.
Android app was deployed using Visual Studio 2015
iOS app was deployed using Phonegap Build service.

company.name: State Commission of Public Services of Tijuana

positions.title: Teacher at Software Developer's career.
positions.description:
Teaching JAVA at High School level, working with AWT, Swing and web applications technologies such Servlets and JSP. Develop native mobile applications with Android in Java. MySQL with Triggers and Stored Procedures.
I worked in a few projects within the institute with JSP, Servlets, JQuery, AWT / Swing, Android and MySQL, using tools such Eclipse, ADT Plugin and MySQL GUI Tools.

company.name: CECYTEBC / College of Science and Technology Studies of Baja California

positions.title: Full stack .Net Developer
positions.description:
Participate in the analysis of client requirements.  
Design and create the user interface of the web application based on a Bootstrap template. 
Create the Models, Views and Controllers. Used of Razor engine on Views & first Code approach in Entity Framework.
Create validation rules with Data Annotation on models. 
Create custom validation rules to use it in Data Annotation on models. 
Used of LINQ to query the database on Entity Framework. 
Call existing stored procedures and stored functions in SQL Server from Models. 
Used of JQuery to get and send data to the database passing JSON objects from Views to Controllers.

positions.title: Full stack .Net Developer
positions.description:
The project objective was to develop a web application platform to create different kind of Quiz to know more about their future students. 
Analyze and design a platform that meets client requirements.
Design and create the User Interface for the web application using Bootstrap.
Create the Model, Views and Controllers
Used of Razor engine on Views & Used First Code approach in Entity Framework.
Create validation rules with Data Annotation on models.
Used of LINQ to query the database on Entity Framework.
Used of JQuery to get and send data to the database passing JSON objects from Views to Controllers.
Develop the dashboard to generate Quizzes to different schools.
Develop the Front end in which students log in to start the Quiz. 
To test and deploy the web application to client’s server.
Install .NET Framework and configurate IIS on client’s server.

positions.title: Full Stack .Net Developer
positions.description:
The project was to develop a web application for job search, in which people could have their resume online so companies could find them, and people could search for a job. It has a client panel where they could publish their job offers and see the people that has applied to a job. 
Participate in the analysis of client’s requirements.
Design and create the user interface of the web application based on a Bootstrap  template.
Create the Models, Views and Controllers.
Used of Razor engine on Views & Used First Code approach in Entity Framework.
Create validation rules with Data Annotation on models.
Create custom validation rules to use it in Data Annotation on models.
Used of LINQ to query the database on Entity Framework.
Used of JQuery to get and send data to the database passing JSON objects from Views to Controllers and vice versa.
Publish the web application to client’s server on a Hosting.
Configure emails account on Hosting to be able to send emails from web application to users.

company.name: National Chamber of the Transformation Industry

positions.title: Backend .Net Developer
positions.description: The Project was to develop a Web Service to be used for online payments. This web service is used by a regional convenient store's POS software to charge our customers in their local stores, so clients doesn’t need to move to out offices to pay their monthly bill. All transactions are being reflected at the moment of the charge.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: The project was to create a web platform in which they could manage all legal resources of their clients, where they could have distinct stages in which a legal resource could take, and different people could review, update and upload files associated with a resource.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: The project was to develop an ERP for a Medical Sales Company. Modules included: Point of sale, inventory, reports, sale orders, buy orders, electronic invoice, and interface to update price products with provider stock via web service. The electronic invoice module was a Desktop application that communicates with web application directly through the database
